lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You did use that. (Brendan nods “yes”) You didn’t carry her out there.

lines.text: (shakes head “no”) mm uh.

lines.text: So you loaded her on the creeper? (Brendan nods “yes”) Is that what it’s called?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And you slid that out to where?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Ta the fire.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. And then you threw her in the fire.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”) uh huh.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And then what did you do with the creeper? (pause) It’s OK, what’d you do with it?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Put it back in the garage.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Is that in the garage now you think?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And that was what color again?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Black and red.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: After she’s in the fire, what do you guys do next?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Go take the jeep down in the pit.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Tell us how.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He drove it down there and

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Were you in the jeep with him?
